# PC Audio Steam to Phone (AS2P)

**PC Audio Steam to Phone (AS2P)** is a low-latency audio streaming solution designed to stream Windows system audio to an Android device in real-time over the network.

### ⚠️ Special Disclaimer
**All code in this project (including the Windows Server and Android App) was automatically generated by the Gemini CLI.**
*   The developer has conducted basic functional testing and confirmed it is operational.
*   The developer **has not conducted a line-by-line manual code review** or refactoring of the internal logic and security mechanisms.
*   This project is currently in the **Prototype** stage and is intended for Proof of Concept (PoC) purposes.

---

## Key Features
*   **Ultra-Low Latency**: Built on Oboe (Android) and WASAPI (Windows) using the Opus codec.
*   **Auto-Discovery**: Supports mDNS (Bonjour); the mobile app can automatically find the server on the local network.
*   **Silence Injection**: Automatically fills silence frames when the PC is muted to prevent audio clipping on the phone.
*   **Bidirectional Sync**: Both the Server and App send "BYE" signals (0x03) to ensure connection states are synchronized when closing.

## Tech Stack
*   **Server**: Rust (`cpal`, `opus`, `eframe`, `mdns-sd`)
*   **App**: Kotlin, C++, Oboe, Opus
*   **Protocol**: UDP (Port 12345), 48kHz Stereo

## How to Use

### 1. Download Pre-compiled Binaries
Go to the [Releases](https://github.com/Anton/PC-Audio-Stream-to-Phone/releases) page to download:
*   Windows: `server.exe`
*   Android: `app-debug.apk`

### 2. Start Streaming
1.  Run `server.exe` on your PC and click **Start Server**.
2.  Install and open the app on your Android phone.
3.  Enter your PC's internal IP address (or use the auto-discovery feature) and click **Connect**.
4.  You should now hear your PC audio playing through your phone!
